# Maiatesta

Maiatesta is a digital agency based in Quito, Ecuador. The website is https://maiatesta.com/.

Maiatesta helps small businesses, entrepreneurs, professionals, restaurants, shops, clinics, academies, and service businesses in Quito and Pichincha with practical digital systems.

Core services:
- Web development and landing pages for businesses in Quito.
- WhatsApp chatbots and AI automation for lead capture and customer support.
- Online stores and e-commerce for Ecuador.
- Inventory software and operational tools for SMEs.
- Excel, spreadsheet, dashboard, and reporting automation.
